core_meaning.primary_meaning: Muadz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who is protected, refuge”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Muadz corresponds to the Arabic form معاذ (Arabic root ع و ذ (ʿ-w-dh); مُعَاذ (Muʿādh)). Its core sense is protected, guarded, safe. Muadz is Arabic مُعَاذ (Muʿādh) 'one who is protected, refuge', from the root ع و ذ (ʿ-w-dh). The source gloss 'Awakener' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as muaath.

persian.name: معاذ
persian.long_meaning: Muadz (معاذ) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن محفوظ، نگه‌داشته، ایمن است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.

hindi.name: मुआज़

arabic.name: معاذ
